`final class SnapshotUrlAssetLocator`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IAssetLocator`](/reference/resources/iassetlocator/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotUrlAssetLocator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotUrlAssetLocator.java)

Downloads an `http` or `https` resource once into the `snapshot` area of the cache folder, so that later snapshot runs work offline.

- [Keep every run identical](/use/learn/running/testing/#keep-every-run-identical)

## Method details

<a id="SnapshotUrlAssetLocator-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(Object handle)` 

If `true`, the handle is a string that starts with `http://` or `https://`.

<a id="SnapshotUrlAssetLocator-method-locate"></a>

### locate

`Asset locate(Object handle)` 

Returns an asset that reads the cached download of the URL, downloading it at the first read.
